anomaly_def.Name: Optimizer Statistics Anomaly + Query Plan Selection Anomaly
anomaly_def.Description:
Optimizer Statistics Anomaly : The metadata that feeds the optimizer—row counts, histograms, correlation and partition statistics—is stale, incomplete or inaccurate, causing systematic cardinality misestimation.
Query Plan Selection Anomaly : The optimizer’s decision logic or plan-reuse mechanism chooses a sub-optimal execution plan even though the statistical inputs are generally available and sound.

When both root causes occur simultaneously, the database can exhibit an amplified mix of symptoms: extreme gaps between estimated and actual row counts, rapid oscillation among widely different plans, sudden regressions after data loads or cache flushes, and high variance in response times for the same SQL text. Plan changes may appear random—sometimes driven by bad statistics, other times by a flawed cost model—making regression patterns hard to reproduce. You may see alternating use of full scans and deeply nested loops, intermittent spills to disk, erratic parallelism activation, and excessive plan recompilations as the optimizer tries to compensate for conflicting cues.

Causally, stale or poorly sampled statistics skew the cost estimates fed into the optimizer, while the plan-selection anomaly magnifies the impact of those skewed numbers by failing to choose a resilient plan or by reusing a parameter-sensitive one. Conversely, even where statistics are marginally acceptable, an overly aggressive or outdated cost model can pick a brittle plan whose performance collapses after the next data change, prompting further statistics churn. The two issues thus reinforce each other: bad statistics mislead the cost model, and a vulnerable plan-selection strategy makes the system more sensitive to every minor statistics deviation, leading to a feedback loop of plan thrashing and performance instability across both transactional and analytical workloads.

entry.cause_analysis: The failure is typically associated with a general engine-level execution problem surfaced by the official error catalogue, but its precise trigger must be interpreted together with workload context and surrounding evidence.
entry.solution_guidance: Review the surrounding workload, official description, and engine state to determine whether the issue is rooted in SQL logic, resource pressure, configuration, or environmental instability.
